visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting a chaotic, close-quarters skirmish in a forest setting. Several figures are engaged in hand-to-hand combat and shooting. One figure is lying on the ground in the foreground with arms raised, while another figure stands over them. Other figures are seen grappling, wielding knives, and holding long-barreled firearms. The background shows dense trees and additional figures partially obscured by the foliage.
